quotes.text: The agent is the opposite of that. It's not designed to do everything under the sun. It's designed to do one thing, and it's designed to do it exceptionally well, because you're going to teach this agent what it needs to know.

quotes.text: you always want to go with the simplest technology that you can because if you start with Foundry on every single agent, you're going to have a tremendous amount of technical debt and it'll be much more expensive to maintain.

quotes.text: But in general, you want to work on the least privilege principle. So whatever the agent needs, it should have the ability to do just that and nothing more.

chapters.title: What is a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent?
SharePoint agents, Agent Builder, Copilot Studio or Foundry?
Autonomous and multi-agent future, rapid-fire round

takeaways: Microsoft 365 Copilot is a generalist, while agents are specialists built from instructions, knowledge and tools to do one job exceptionally well.
Secure and govern your data before turning on AI, because agents and Copilot will surface every overshared file.
Start with the simplest option, such as a SharePoint agent, and apply least privilege before moving to Copilot Studio, custom engine agents or Foundry.
hook: Many organizations stop at chatting with AI and never build agents that deliver business value. Mirko Peters and Microsoft MVP Steve Corey walk IT decision-makers, architects and developers through agent anatomy, tool choice from SharePoint agents to Foundry, and the security model that keeps agents from going rogue.
